fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 is killed as a reduction mechanism. A fixed cyclotomic block can at most impose constant local trace separation; dropping a selector gives zero embedding energy, and independent copies remain additive under O8, so neither overlap soundness nor a polynomial gap follows.

Proposal 2 is killed in its present form. Reed–Solomon distance applies to codewords, while multiplication and re-encoding are linearized with joint selectors that can admit O4 affine pseudocodewords; the finite-field-to-integral CVP lift, carries, weights, and an unbounded coefficient certificate are also unspecified.

Proposal 3 is killed. Field cosystolic expansion does not automatically give the required integral Euclidean inequality for unrestricted coefficients, and a complete six-vertex complex cannot discriminate asymptotic expansion because every support is constant-sized; no explicit twisted boundary construction excludes O2/O4 affine lifts.

Proposal 4 is killed. Noncommutative ordered products are not enforced by linear representation-valued conservation; expanding finite-group states reduces the construction to an ordinary linear flow cover where O6 signed cycles remain, while enumeration only through l1 norm 6 would not certify the unrestricted fiber.

Proposal 6 is killed. Local Delaunay empty-sphere properties have no supplied preservation theorem under lattice fiber products, and overlap points, drops, or additive radius growth remain exactly O2/O5/O7; the proposed gluing does not specify an integral lattice, center, target, or acceptance threshold.

Proposal 7 is killed. Quaternion no-zero-divisors applies to actual rank-one products, not unrestricted signed joint-selector mixtures; bilinear linearization restores O4/O7 entanglement, a zero factor annihilates the product, and norm-one nonhonest units defeat the claimed defect distinction.

Proposal 5 remains blocked from any theorem by the G13/G15 affine-lift risk and by O8: even charging every dense attack proportionally to the number of bags yields only a constant relative cost unless a superlinear scaling law is proved. It nevertheless has one precise finite falsifier that distinguishes whether larger bags eliminate the known affine pseudodistribution.
evidence: Generation 13 verified that the harmful parity selector is an exact integral affine combination of 16 honest encodings and is invisible to every compatible raw linear syndrome.
Generation 15 verified that those same affine coefficients lift with zero residual through every node of the tested hierarchy, below its claimed threshold.

Generation 14 verified that complete pair bags exclude attacks only through the finite shell B+32; no scaling law followed. Larger 3/4-clause bags therefore test a real unresolved boundary rather than repeating an already settled case.

Generations 32 and 37 verified additive compatible parity across copies, including the exact universal equality W2=2W1 in the frozen metric family. Thus finite local separation cannot be promoted to composition or polynomial hardness.
Generation 30 verified that unrestricted tensor coefficients invalidate rank-one composition reasoning, directly undermining the analogous quaternion argument.
All seven proposed experiments are presently unexecuted; none supplies verifier evidence or an asymptotic soundness lemma.
